svg.title: Hy3 Study Clinic — a persistent course, with evidence that earns its place
svg.desc: Three numbered regions: ground a learner-approved course; learn and recover without formal credit; earn formal evidence through local admission and evidence gates. Hy3 semantic work and local authority are marked H and L, with dual badges on mixed components. Formal Repair and due review return to a fresh formal candidate. Distinct teaching records, formal progress, Knowledge Map projection, durable mastery and FSRS review sit over shared, versioned SQLite history. Deep transfer is conditional on deep-transfer courses.

svg.title: Study Clinic — from uncertainty to understanding

svg.text: Learner-owned materials. A persistent course. Evidence that earns its place.
Scheduled after required teaching · local authority decides credit

a.text: Hy3 support → local source / rubric checks

a.title: Assessment & grading — Independent attempt · Hy3 rubric; Local score · immutable grade | apps/server/src/services/learnerAssessments.ts, apps/server/src/services/formalAssessments.ts, packages/shared/src/domain/transferAssessment.ts
a.text: Score alone earns no formal credit

a.title: Evidence gate — Required criteria + current route; Partial evidence earns no progress | packages/shared/src/domain/formalAssessment.ts, apps/server/src/services/formalAssessments.ts

Supported evidence — Source-bound evidence record; Separate progress reconciliation | apps/server/src/services/formalAssessments.ts, apps/server/src/repositories/formalAssessments.ts, apps/server/src/services/formalProgression.ts

Formal Repair — Failed rubric → targeted repair; Fresh assessment of the same target | apps/server/src/services/repair.ts, apps/server/src/services/learnerAssessments.ts, apps/server/src/services/courseActionLaunch.ts
a.text: Hy3 packet · local diagnosis, lifecycle & target binding

svg.text: Fresh verification → candidate → Admission Gate → Evidence Gate

a.title: Deep-transfer courses only — After an eligible objective checkpoint; New-scenario task; Source criteria and all four performance criteria | apps/server/src/services/acceptedCoursePlan.ts, packages/shared/src/domain/transferAssessment.ts, apps/server/src/services/learnerAssessments.ts

Formal progress — Supported evidence plus current route; Separate local reconciliation into progress | apps/server/src/services/formalAssessments.ts, apps/server/src/services/formalProgression.ts, apps/server/src/services/courseLearningProgress.ts

Knowledge Map — Projection of accepted course and learner state; Teaching, evidence and mastery remain distinct; Never a source of course or credit authority | apps/server/src/services/knowledgeMap.ts

Durable mastery — Supported and reconciled evidence; Representation diversity and sufficient demand; Delayed unseen evidence; Completed route and no current review failure | packages/shared/src/domain/formalProgression.ts, apps/server/src/services/courseLearningProgress.ts
a.text: Route complete; no current review failure

a.title: Due review · FSRS — Separate memory schedule; Fresh evidence feeds the next review | apps/server/src/review/fsrsAdapter.ts, apps/server/src/services/reviewSuccessor.ts

Persistent course record · SQLite — Source + curriculum versions; Lesson, response and Tutor history; Assessments, grades, evidence and Repair; Sessions, progress and review state | apps/server/src/db/database.ts, apps/server/src/repositories/index.ts, apps/server/src/repositories/lessonExecution.ts, apps/server/src/repositories/studySessions.ts, apps/server/src/services/generationStages.ts
a.text: SHARED ACROSS EVERY STAGE · VERSIONED HISTORY · RESUMABLE SESSIONS

objective checkpoint"}],"constraints":["All model content is a proposal or semantic observation until the relevant local validation accepts it.","No direct Hy3-to-authoritative-state write arrow.","Lesson, Tutor, hints, Practice and informal Retest do not create Formal Evidence.","Practice recovery is stored inside lesson execution, not converted into a Formal Repair episode or generic durable misconception diagnosis.","Legacy MistakeRecord/concept mastery APIs remain in code; they are not the state machine for ordinary lesson Practice.","Knowledge Map is a read-only course/graph/state projection, not the authority that authors or approves the curriculum.","Deep transfer adds a unit-transfer assessment after an eligible objective checkpoint; it must pass source and performance criteria.","Formal candidate rejection does not imply successful learning or permanent rejection of the course; a valid successor can be attempted.","A high aggregate grade alone does not establish supported evidence; only supported evidence can be reconciled into formal progress.","FSRS scheduling and durable mastery are different policies.
